description: Is a vendor down right now? Current outage status for one SaaS vendor. $0.01 USDC on Base per call. Returns status, active-incident summary, last-checked time, source URL and freshness fields, read live from PulseWatch. Unknown vendors return 404, not charged. Don't use this for past incidents; use /v1/incidents. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: pulsewatch_status
title: PulseWatch Status API: GET /v1/status
